notes.title: Biolab Wars DX: Important update on the way!
notes.notes:
Attention! Biolab Wars will receive an important update soon!

We are planning a major update, including the following improvements:

Shooting in 8 directions!
Ammunition rebalancing;
More bullets!
Decrease in knockback;
New stage between the last miniboss and the final boss.
...and other minor improvements.

All of this will be available for free to everyone who already owns the game.

But be aware:  on April 20th, the price of Biolab Wars will be adjusted.

Therefore, you can still buy it at the current price until April 20th. Take advantage of it!

Q: Why is there going to be a price adjustment?
A: With the arrival of Wild Dogs, we believe that more people will look for Biolab Wars. Therefore, we decided to invest in significant improvements.

Q: I already own the game, do I need to pay anything extra for these improvements?
A: No! You don't need to pay anything extra. The improvements will be free for everyone who already owns the game.

Q: Will I still have access to the old version?
A: Yes! You will have two versions of Biolab Wars to play whenever you want.
